title: {Syn} Vision Transformers Asked Images to Become Patches
content:
Vision Transformers split an image into patches and process those patches much like tokens in a sentence. With enough data, the architecture competes strongly in vision tasks.

ViT helped show that convolution was not the only viable inductive bias for high-performing image models.

Why it matters: ai papers keeps producing ideas that are simple enough to state and strong enough to build with.
